standard.title: Develop narratives and share observations
standard.description: develop narratives and share observations, using sources, and subject-specific terms
standard.prior_knowledge: From Y1 (AC9HS1S06): Students developed historical narratives using sources and time sequence vocabulary.
standard.progression_endpoint: Students develop narratives and share observations, using sources and subject-specific terms for time and place.

nodes.label: Subject-specific vocabulary for time and place
nodes.progression_checkpoint: Students can use time terms (in the past, years ago, the olden days, in the future) and direction/location terms (north, south, opposite, near, far) accurately in HASS communication.
nodes.minimum_width: Use at least two time terms and two direction/location terms correctly in a spoken or written description.
nodes.typical_width: Use time terms (in the past, years ago, olden days, in the future) and location terms (north, south, opposite, near, far) when sharing observations about how access to and use of a place has changed; use vocabulary in speech and writing.
wider: Compare how time and direction terms from different languages map onto HASS vocabulary
Create a subject-specific vocabulary reference resource for Year 2 HASS that includes definitions and examples
nodes.hinge_reason: Without accurate time and place vocabulary, narratives and observations lack the specificity the HASS descriptor demands — vocabulary is the communicative tool.

response_modes.reason: Direction terms (north, south) are new at Year 2 — build fluency through maps, orientation activities and labelling before deploying in narratives.

success_criteria: Uses at least two time terms correctly in HASS context
Uses at least one cardinal direction term correctly in a location description

nodes.label: Developing narratives from sources
nodes.progression_checkpoint: Students can develop narratives drawing on ideas from sources and share observations about how access to and use of a place has changed over time.
nodes.minimum_width: Develop a narrative or observation report drawing on at least one source and using at least two subject-specific terms.
nodes.typical_width: Develop narratives drawing on comparisons of past and present daily life; share observations using sources about how a place's use has changed; share knowledge about the past using time and place terms in speech and writing.
wider: Develop a narrative that draws on perspectives of at least two different groups represented in the sources
Create a multimodal observation report about a local place that includes maps, photographs and written explanation

response_modes.reason: Narrative development integrates source use, vocabulary, perspective awareness and factual knowledge into a communicated whole — it is the communicating endpoint for Year 2.

success_criteria: Develops a narrative or observation report that draws on at least one source
Uses at least two subject-specific terms accurately
